preconditions.description: Attacker must have the owner role of the contract to call the `changeFees` function.

exploit_hint: As the owner, call the `changeFees` function, setting both `_marketingFeeSell` and `_teamFeeSell` to 0. This causes the `totalBNBFee` variable within the `swapBack` function to become zero. Subsequently, trigger the `swapBack` function by performing a token transfer that makes the contract's token balance meet or exceed the `swapThreshold`. The `_transferFrom` function will then attempt to call `swapBack`, which will revert due to a division-by-zero error. This permanently breaks the fee distribution mechanism and traps any collected fees in the contract.
